claims.text: The hotel's history dates back to 1872.

findings.quote: Since 1872 we have endeavoured to offer you a work of art, as Oscar Wilde used to say

claims.text: The hotel has a subtropical park, with the sea in front of it.

findings.quote: the sight by the subtropical park, the swimming-pool designed by Gio Ponti and the sea in front

claims.text: The Lawrence Lounge pairs mixology and cuisine, with live musical entertainment.

findings.quote: A place where mixology and cuisine of excellence meet to offer a unique taste experience, at any time of the day.
The engaging and cosmopolitan atmosphere, combined with live musical entertainment

claims.text: The restaurants serve Ligurian and Mediterranean cuisine with flavours of land and sea.

findings.quote: Our dishes are full of true flavours of land and sea, conceived and created to offer you the best of typical Ligurian and Mediterranean cuisine.

claims.text: The Royal Wellness spa has a Vitarium and a Turkish bath made of pearl mosaic.

findings.quote: in the Vitarium at 60°C/140°F, in the Turkish bath at 40°C/104°F made of pearl mosaic

claims.text: The spa's wet zone has a large hydromassage pool and emotional showers.

findings.quote: the Royal Wellness welcomes you in the no prescription wet zone with large hydromassage pool, emotional showers, Turkish bath and Vitarium.

claims.text: Spa treatments use the Mei SPA line, made with natural ingredients from Italian officinal plants.

findings.quote: featuring the exclusive line Mei SPA made with natural phytocosmetic ingredients obtained from officinal plants "Made in Italy"

claims.text: Guests can play tennis and mini-golf on site.

findings.quote: You can play tennis or mini-golf on site.

claims.text: Children up to 6 stay free when sharing their parents' room.

findings.quote: Children free of charge up to 6 years, sharing parents’ room

claims.text: In July and August a pizzeria runs at the Corallina Restaurant by the pool.

findings.quote: Pizzeria in July and August at the Corallina Restaurant by the pool

claims.text: Sanremo is about 60 minutes from Nice International Airport and 45 minutes from Monte-Carlo.

findings.quote: just 60 minutes from Nice International airport and 45 minutes from Monte-Carlo

claims.text: Nearby landmarks include Sanremo's medieval old town, known as La Pigna.

findings.quote: We suggest you visit the following landmarks: the medieval old town centre known as "La Pigna"

claims.text: The swimming pool was designed by Gio Ponti in 1948 and sits in the hotel's park facing the Mediterranean.

findings.quote: The Mediterranean sea and the scenographic swimming-pool designed by Gio Ponti in 1948 perfectly complete the park and the hotel.

claims.text: The Lawrence Lounge in the lobby is named after the hotel's founder, Lorenzo Bertolini.

findings.quote: Inspired by the name of the hotel's founder Lorenzo Bertolini, the new Lawrence Lounge, the star of our lobby

claims.text: The outdoor pool is heated, filled with seawater and has a children's area.

findings.quote: Heated outdoor seawater pool with children’s area (April to October)

claims.text: Sea excursions into the Pelagos Sanctuary marine protected area offer the chance to spot dolphins and whales.

findings.quote: the Pelagos Sanctuary, a protected marine area where nature reveals itself in all its magnificence. During exclusive sea excursions, guests can enjoy the rare thrill of spotting dolphins, whales

claims.text: The 18-hole Circolo Golf degli Ulivi, designed by Peter Gannon and inaugurated in 1932, sits on the hill above Sanremo among olive and mimosa trees.

findings.quote: designed by Peter Gannon and inaugurated in 1932. It has 18 holes and is nestled amidst olive and mimosa trees on the hill above Sanremo

claims.text: The Royal Wellness spa is reserved for adults; guests aged 16 and over may use it when accompanied by an adult.

findings.quote: is reserved for adult guests. Guests aged 16 and over may also access the wellness area, provided they are accompanied by an adult.

claims.text: The heated outdoor pool is open from April to October.

findings.quote: Heated outdoor seawater pool with children’s area (April to October)

claims.text: The Circolo Golf degli Ulivi is off-site, on the hill above Sanremo.

findings.quote: nestled amidst olive and mimosa trees on the hill above Sanremo
a wide range of outdoor activities just a short distance from the hotel
